newsitem.title: CHINA: China hopes to see Japan trade at $100 bln by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China hopes to see Japan trade at $100 bln by 2000.

text.p: China hopes to expand trade with Japan to $100 billion a year by the end of the century, Chinese Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Wu Yi told her Japanese counterpart Shinji Sato on Monday.
Bilateral trade between China and Japan totalled more than $60 billion in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said.
Wu told Japan's Minister of International Trade and Industry that she hoped the two countries would strengthen exchanges between their government, Xinhua reported but gave no more details.
